purpose: Make the large project navigable without relying on chat memory. Every important file has one declared role; authority, live execution, domain planning, historical snapshots, runtime data, source, automation and assets are not allowed to masquerade as each other.
authority_chain: Data/MasterExecutionRoadmap.json = current dependency/order map subordinate to Governor.
Docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md = human-readable operational handoff, never authority over Governor.
organization_rules: Do not physically mass-move Data/Docs/SourceAssets during W00 just for neatness; moves require a dedicated maintenance batch and validator/import impact review.
Historical audits preserve evidence and are not rewritten into current authority.
A plan with stale embedded PR/branch metadata may still contain useful domain design, but current control state comes only from Governor/MasterExecutionRoadmap.
Any new accepted requirement must enter Governor and be mapped into the execution roadmap in the same logical change.
Any new broad completeness category must enter WholeGameAZCompletenessMapV1; living-world micro-details additionally enter LivingWorldMasterCoverageMapV1.
Source code remains Public headers / Private implementations; do not regress the CP154 migration.
Animated production characters use skeletal FBX; project-owned OBJ character pieces are foundation/proxy sources only and never count as final animated-character completion.

known_stale_or_historical_metadata.issue: Contains historical PR #53 / branch work/automation-first-runtime-observation control metadata.
known_stale_or_historical_metadata.treatment: Keep domain design as reference; do not use its embedded PR/branch as current execution truth. Current PR/branch come from Governor/MasterExecutionRoadmap.
Historical evidence is retained. Promotion decisions require current exact-head evidence and Governor reconciliation.

physical_cleanup_gate.future_trigger: Only perform physical Data/Docs restructuring when a concrete maintenance benefit outweighs path/validator/runtime-data churn, and prove it on an exact engine-tested head.
